name: Ethersworn
description: Humans, vedalken and sphinxes dedicated to infusing all life with etherium, a quest called the Noble Work.

description_citations.text: "Esper". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vronos finds himself among the Ethersworn vedalken, who first judge him imperfect and then value him as a new planeswalker.
timeline.quote: This one might be of value.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Vronos studies etherium and the Twenty-Three Texts with the Ethersworn, repairs his face with an etherium infix and mask, and learns to planeswalk and track other planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: he honed his planeswalking skill and discovered how to track others like himself by the faint trails they left in the Æther.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Crucius and the Ethersworn perfect their designs on drakes before infusing the first humanoid with etherium.
timeline.quote: spent years perfecting their designs on drakes before infusing the first humanoid.

citation.text: "Drake", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Ethersworn contact Vronos, who agrees to planeswalk in a controlled setting in exchange for knowledge.
timeline.quote: In exchange for knowledge, Vronos agreed to planeswalk in a controlled setting for the Ethersworn for a while.

citation.text: "Esper", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The zealots who govern Esper and seek to infuse all life with etherium.
